# Fireflies

Fireflies.ai helps your team transcribe, summarize, search, and analyze voice conversations.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fireflies/.

## Actions

- **Add to Live Meeting**: The addtolive action allows you to add the fireflies.ai bot to an ongoing meeting.
- **Delete Transcript by ID**: The deletetranscriptbyid action is designed to delete a specific transcript by its id.
- **Fetch AI App Outputs** (read-only): Fetch outputs for a specific ai app or meeting/transcript.
- **Get Bite by ID** (read-only): The getbite action is designed to fetch details associated with a specific bite id.
- **Get Transcript by ID** (read-only): The gettranscriptbyid action is designed to fetch details associated with a specific transcript id.
- **Get Transcripts** (read-only): The getbites action is designed to fetch a list of bites against input arguments.
- **Get Transcripts** (read-only): The gettranscripts action is designed to fetch a list of transcripts against input arguments.
- **Get User by ID** (read-only): The getuser action is designed to fetch details associated with a specific user id.
- **Get Users** (read-only): The getusers action is designed to fetch a list of all users within the team.
- **Upload Audio**: The uploadaudio action allows you to upload audio files to fireflies.ai for transcription.
